title: fix(app-shell,i18n): the designer's flow, federated-panel and field-stub chrome speak the user's language (objectui#10862, slice 4)
body:
Fixes #10862
Clause-②: no

Slice 4 of objectui#10862, the designer-English family's carrier card: the nine files the slice-3 closure census left English under zh-CN, carried by release `5866807114` and claim `5895363747`. Dispatched by the `domain:ui` seat 2 PM (session `session_011p7ikEivgXefNDaE5S5Uec`), implemented on `claude/issue-10862-designer-english-slice-4` from `main` `8a5ae3d63`. Same shape as slices 1 to 3: catalogue rows whose en value is the literal each replaces, plus zh, read in the designer locale the surface receives. No second catalogue.

**Why the closing keyword.** The closure census below reads every source file in `metadata-admin/previews/` and `metadata-admin/external/` and finds no rendered designer word left English under zh-CN after this slice, with one exception the dispatch order rules out of this card: `AppNavCanvas`'s positional nav-item fallback (`Item N`, inside `navLabel`), which the order assigns to objectui#11128's label logic ("do not touch `AppNavCanvas.tsx`'s label logic"). It is listed under Acceptance notes so that card can carry it. If the seat reads that fallback as this card's instead, the first line should become `Part of #10862`.

## What changed

All under `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`.

- **`i18n.ts`**: 55 en rows, each equal to the literal it replaces, and 55 zh rows with the same placeholders. Rows sit beside their family: `engine.externalDatasource.browser.*` / `.check.*` / `.diff.*` / `.import.*` beside the panel's slice-3 rows, `engine.flowCanvas.edge.*` / `.summary.*`, `engine.flowPreview.varIn` / `varOut`, `engine.flowRuns.runId` / `trigger`, `engine.form.objectNotFound` / `datasetNotFound` beside `engine.form.noObjectFields` (the sentence they fill), and `designer.stub.address` beside the other `designer.stub.*` placeholders. Three existing rows are reused with the same English and meaning: `engine.cancel`, `engine.close`, and `engine.externalDatasource.unavailable` (the import dialog's federation-unavailable error is that exact sentence).
- **`external/SchemaBrowser.tsx`** (the tables tab): filter placeholder, refresh button, introspecting / no-remote-tables / no-match notes, the three table headers, the per-row import button, and the unavailable hint. The hint is one row with a `{service}` hole that `withNodes` fills with the `external-datasource` code span.
- **`external/ValidationPanel.tsx`** (the validation tab): unavailable note, intro (a `{datasource}` hole for the code span), run button, the all-match / diverging summaries and the per-object diff count (One / Other rows, keyed on the same count the literal pluralised on), the `expected … , actual …` line (two holes), and the ten diff-kind badges. `DIFF_LABEL` becomes `DIFF_LABEL_KEY`, still typed `Record` over the spec's `SchemaDiffEntry['kind']`, so a kind added upstream still fails the build until it has a row.
- **`external/ImportObjectDialog.tsx`**: title and import button, intro (two holes), draft progress, object name, review count (One / Other), generated-source heading, importing, imported confirmation (a `{name}` hole) and its next-step line, cancel / close. The federation-unavailable error is held as a marker in state and read as a row at render, so it follows a language switch; any other failure is the server's own message, shown as it came.
- **`previews/FlowCanvas.tsx`**: an edge's hover title for an un-declared cycle and for a back-edge; the node card's summary words (`N branches`, `N approver(s)` with the ` · all` unanimous marker, `code`). `nodeSummary` takes the canvas `locale`. The plain `source → target` title is notation and stays.
- **`previews/FlowPreview.tsx`**: the variables panel's `in` / `out` tags.
- **`previews/FlowRunsPanel.tsx`**: an expanded run's `run …` and ` · trigger …` parts (the ` · ` separator stays in code).
- **`previews/FieldStub.tsx`**: the address stub's three-line placeholder.
- **`previews/useObjectFields.ts`** and **`previews/useDatasetCatalog.ts`** (`useDatasetSemantics`): the hooks record that the server answered with no document and read `engine.form.objectNotFound` / `engine.form.datasetNotFound` where they return, in `useMetadataLocale()`. Measured before choosing: neither hook receives a locale, and the string is not rendered by any single site; it reaches the add-field popover's `engine.form.noObjectFields` sentence (view column manager, report and dashboard widget dataset editors) and the inspectors' roster-failure notices. Translating in the hook once keeps every one of those sites right; a transport error still passes through as the transport's message, and a language switch re-reads the row without a refetch.
- **Locale source for the three `external/` files**: each reads `useMetadataLocale()`, the value the panel's own `locale` prop carries in production (`DatasourcePreview`'s hosts all pass that hook's value), as slice 3's column manager did. No host was edited, so the file surface is the claim's nine files plus `i18n.ts`, the pins and the changeset.
- One `.changeset/10862-designer-federation-flow-stub-locale.md` (`patch` for `@object-ui/app-shell`).

## H1 census, confirmed per file

A site is one rendered designer word: an element's text, a `title`, or a `placeholder`. Every site is read by a pin through the real component.

| file | rows | rendered sites | not counted, and why |
|:--|--:|--:|:--|
| `SchemaBrowser` | 10 | 10 | table and schema names, column counts, the row estimate (display-locale number, objectui#9909's channel), a load failure's own message; `external-datasource` (a service name, inside the sentence) |
| `ValidationPanel` | 21 | 18 | object names, remote names, columns, expected / actual values; a diff kind outside the typed map shows its raw token, as before |
| `ImportObjectDialog` | 10 (+3 reused) | 13 | remote table and datasource names, the draft's name, review columns, remote types and notes, the generated source (the server's words), a draft or import failure's own message |
| `FlowCanvas` | 7 | 5 | node ids in edge titles; the `source → target` title (notation); `else` / `if …` branch pills (code-line tokens, as `FlowSimulatorPanel` prints them); config values and a stored `behavior` token in summaries |
| `FlowPreview` | 2 | 2 | variable names and types; the `hint` props (`PreviewShell` does not render them) |
| `FlowRunsPanel` | 2 | 1 | run id, trigger type, step status and node ids (producer tokens), durations (notation) |
| `FieldStub` | 1 | 1 | the example placeholders (`name@example.com`, `hh:mm`, `#3b82f6`, …) and an author's own placeholder |
| `useObjectFields` | 1 | 1 | a transport error's message |
| `useDatasetCatalog` | 1 | 1 | a transport error's message |

Totals: 55 new rows and 3 reused rows; 52 rendered sites (a plural One / Other pair is one site; three of the import dialog's sites read the reused rows).

**Closure census over `previews/` and `external/`.** An AST pass (string literals, template literals and JSX text in every non-test source file, enumerated with `git ls-tree` at the head: 66 files), then each hit read at source. Left as written after this slice, with the reason:

- identifiers, paths, keys, class strings, selection ids, and `hint` props (unrendered);
- code spans and code-line tokens: `navigation`, `groups`, `include`, `pages`, `reference`, `else`, `true` / `false`, `if …`;
- names of standards and notation: `Cron`, `SSL`, `JSON Schema`, `hh:mm`, `Nms`, JSON-schema type labels (`any`, `ref`), the permission scope tokens and `readable=… editable=…`;
- stored values the designer writes: a new widget's default title, a new field group's default label, `region_N`;
- unreachable fallbacks: `AddWidgetPicker`'s and `OutlineStrip`'s default labels (every host passes a localized one), `PagePreview`'s `region N`, `ActionPreview`'s inherited-target stand-in, `ColumnChip` (no production importer);
- English fallbacks translated at render elsewhere: `extractRegions`' `Branch N` / `Try` / `Catch` (`flow-region-label.ts`), `groupEntries`' `Ungrouped`, the node palette's labels and categories, the block, field and widget type tables (each read through a key);
- **`AppNavCanvas`'s `Item N`**: reachable and English under zh-CN; ruled out of this card by the dispatch order (see the top).

## H2: every production host passes the locale

- `FlowCanvas` and `FlowRunsPanel` have one host, `FlowPreview`, which passes its `locale` to both (unchanged); `FlowPreview` reads the `locale` every registered-preview host passes (`ResourceEditPage`, `EmbeddedItemEditor`, `StudioDesignSurface`, each `useMetadataLocale()`).
- `FieldStub` has one host, `ObjectFormCanvas`, which passes its `locale` (unchanged).
- `SchemaBrowser`, `ValidationPanel` and `ImportObjectDialog` read `useMetadataLocale()` themselves; the pins mount them through `DatasourcePreview` under the provider in the case's language.
- The two hooks read `useMetadataLocale()` themselves; every component that calls them sits under the same provider.

## Pins

Two new files mount the real components under `I18nProvider` in the case's language: `previews/federationTabs.i18n-10862-s4.test.tsx` (23 cases, through `DatasourcePreview`) and `previews/flowFieldChrome.i18n-10862-s4.test.tsx` (17 cases, through `FlowPreview`, `FieldStub`, `FieldsListEditor` and `DashboardWidgetInspector`). Every zh expectation is read back from the catalogue and guarded by `zhRow` (neither the echoed key nor the en row); every en case reads the en row through `t` / `tFormat` for `en-US`, the control that the en row renders what the literal rendered. A case reads every site before it judges, so a failing case lists each missing site; buttons a case only clicks are found in either language, so a red run reaches the sites behind them. Two cases pin the language-switch behaviour: the hook's not-found reason and the dialog's unavailable error re-read in zh after a switch, with one object read and one draft request.

- **Red run on the base** (the nine changed sources checked out at `8a5ae3d63`, blobs equal base; `i18n.ts` and the pins at head `4305c8bac`; trap restore by `git checkout HEAD`, blobs equal head, `git diff HEAD` 0 bytes, porcelain 0 lines): `Tests 20 failed | 20 passed (40)`. The 20 are the 18 zh site cases and the 2 language-switch cases. They list 62 missing sites over 58 keys: all 55 new rows and the 3 reused rows. All 19 en cases pass against the base sources, and so does the zh transport-error case, the pass-through control.
- **Ablation** through `ablation-replace.mjs` on `useObjectFields.ts`: the hook's `useMetadataLocale()` read replaced by a fixed `en-US` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `3030f6af` to `00187940`) gives `Tests 2 failed | 15 passed (17)` on the flow / field / hooks file: exactly the zh missing-object case and the language-switch case; the dataset hook's case, reading its own locale, stays green. Restored: blob equals head `3030f6af`, `git diff HEAD` empty. The pins import sources by relative path, so no `dist` sits between mutation and run.
- **Green at head `e4995797a`**: both pin files inside the consumer sweep below.

## Consumer sweep

At head `e4995797a`, four locked batches: `metadata-admin/previews/` + `external/` `Test Files 82 passed (82)`, `Tests 1103 passed (1103)`; `metadata-admin/inspectors/` `Test Files 113 passed (113)`, `Tests 1576 passed | 1 skipped (1577)`; the other 150 `metadata-admin` test files `Test Files 150 passed (150)`, `Tests 1453 passed (1453)`; `studio-design/` with the console's designer preview-sample and Studio route tests `Test Files 71 passed (71)`, `Tests 426 passed (426)`. Each batch exited 0.

## Gates

`turbo run build --filter=@object-ui/app-shell^...` 28 of 28; `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exit 0. Exit 0 each: `check:i18n-designer-parity`, `check:i18n-drift` (55 keys added, 0 en values changed), `check:i18n-keys`, `check:designer-field-key-parity`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, `check:changeset-claims` (report), `check:pending-changeset-literals` (report), `check:i18n-dead-keys` (report; none of the new rows), `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-changeset-overwrite`, `check-governed-queue-guard --test` (NOT GOVERNED, 13 paths). ESLint over the 12 changed TypeScript files: 0 errors; each modified source file's error / warning counts equal its base blob's, with and without `--no-inline-config`; the two pin files 0 / 0. Not measured locally: the full `pnpm test` and `pnpm lint` farms (CI's), and a browser drive of the preview gallery.

## Acceptance notes

- **`AppNavCanvas`'s `Item N`** (the `navLabel` fallback for an item with no string label) renders English under zh-CN. The dispatch order assigns that function to objectui#11128, whose own direction keeps `Item N` for a label that is truly absent; that card is the natural place to read it through a row, and nothing here touches the file.
- **The preview gallery**: `apps/console/src/preview-gallery.tsx` mounts `I18nProvider` in `en` and feeds `?locale=` only to the typed `locale` prop, so the sites read through `useMetadataLocale()` (the three `external/` files and the two hooks) stay English in the gallery under `?locale=zh-CN`. It is the dev-harness gap already disclosed on the family's earlier PRs; production hosts pass the hook's own value.
- `ExternalDatasourcePanel` (slice 3) still keeps its translated unavailable sentence in state across a language switch until the next refresh, as slice 3's release noted; this slice's dialog does not.
- The address stub's row is `designer.stub.address`, beside the other `designer.stub.*` placeholder rows in the same table, rather than an `engine.*` key.
